standard_prerequisites.name: Finite flat morphisms
standard_prerequisites.relation: finite + flat + fp = finite locally free

core_obligations: Flat + finite at a level: descend-flat-fp and descend-finite-fp together give f_i flat and finite; with f_i lfp the finite-flat lemma makes it finite locally free.

Degree control: the degree-d locus W_d is open and closed in Y_i; the image of Y -> Y_i lies in W_d; limit-contained-in-constructible moves the containment to Y_{i'} -> Y_i for some i' >= i; conclude f_{i'} finite locally free of degree d.
proof_roadmap: Combine the flat and finite engines.
Finite flat + lfp = finite locally free.
Degree-d locus containment via the constructible engine.
difficulty_reason: Two engines (descend-flat-fp + descend-finite-fp) give flat finite f_i; the finite-flat lemma gives finite locally free; the degree-d locus W_d is open-and-closed and the image containment argument via limit-contained-in-constructible controls the degree.

compared.difference: The sibling is the finite statement without local freeness or degree control (delivered as L30260); this lemma adds the finite locally free conclusion and the degree bookkeeping. Different statements.
